record.question: India's target year to achieve Net Zero greenhouse gas emissions is:
record.explanation: Answer D: 2070. India announced its net-zero target year as 2070. Reference: https://pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1768712. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: General Studies Paper-II, January 2026 examination; current affairs are interpreted as of the paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
